Existing source-linked component contracts; see proofs/README.md for assumptions and scope. No global correctness claim.

Complete original existing-identity-first search, empty-slot fallback, eager unit error, indexed get_or_insert, initialization and tag dispatch. Checked capacity, search bounds, exact full error, other-slot frame, selected identity and exact existing/new record effects, unchanged full-error state and preservation of identity uniqueness. Exact flag and identity observations and sufficient insertion capacity are checked and composed with constructors. Reachable caller contracts, Rust search/index/equality/ownership/layout/source refinement remain open.
Complete source-derived query agrees with nonempty old-voter projection; successful stable construction is not joint. Source/value refinement and reachable configuration lifecycle remain open.

Complete original identity query with typed structural equality and flag predicate. Source-derived contracts connect is_voter to current/old voter sequences and show voters participate. Constructor/identity uniqueness, reachable callers and Rust equality/store/source refinement remain open.

Complete original guarded by-value merge retains both original is_joint queries, voter projection, insertion loop and per-insertion error mapping. Success preserves target capacity, target uniqueness (from its input), target voter/learner sets, and makes source voters exactly the old voter set. Identity-union acceptance and Full rejection are checked for unique targets; either joint input yields Reconfiguring with guard priority. Nonempty/valid deployment membership, authorization, committed configuration lineage, reachable callers and Rust source/ownership/equality/layout refinement remain open.

Complete original copied-field iterator projection with exact ordered output and source-record origin; composition with finalized preserves voter/learner sequences and empties old voters. Arbitrary capacities and holes are modeled. Constructor/caller invariants and Rust ownership/layout/lifetime and source-to-IR refinement remain open.

Complete original checked slice batches and insertion callee; stable constructor forwards its exact input/empty-slice arguments. Successful results preserve capacity, establish identity uniqueness and exact voter/old-voter/learner sets and identity union. Acceptance holds iff voters are nonempty, each input is distinct, learners are disjoint from target voters, and the distinct identity union fits capacity; otherwise the result is Config. Stable results have no old voters and are not joint. Reachable callers, remaining membership transformations and Rust source/ownership/index/equality refinement remain open.

Complete original copied-field iterator projection with exact ordered output and source-record origin; composition with finalized preserves voter/learner sequences and empties old voters. Arbitrary capacities and holes are modeled. Constructor/caller invariants and Rust ownership/layout/lifetime and source-to-IR refinement remain open.

Complete original Copy array.map/Option.map body preserves capacity and every empty/present slot position, returns exactly the stored identities, and composes with successful restore/new to recover their input identity union. Reachable peer-slot reconciliation, stale-response identity binding and Rust source/ownership/layout refinement remain open.

Complete original quorum body lowered to the generic owned-callback protocol. Checked contracts retain current/old voter projections, strict majority thresholds, stateful callback sequencing, stable short circuit, empty-current cleanup and a response budget. This is generated-IR component evidence; Rust source/ownership/unwind/usize refinement, caller validity and cross-configuration safety remain open.

Complete original callback loops, prefix sorts, rank expressions, early return and minimum lower to the numeric interaction model. Contracts connect both source projections, stable execution and empty-current panic. Numeric scalar rank contracts and an unbounded indexed-buffer/prefix-sort-to-collection refinement are reusable Provium evidence; the execution contract now uses the buffer refinement. The complete two-pass typed-word execution, including increments and rank reads, refines the source-derived model under explicit width/capacity premises. Rust memory/usize/sort_unstable/ownership/source refinement, build-to-panic-policy binding, panic detail and reachable caller invariants remain open. The callback response budget and observation completion now cover both numeric passes and cleanup, conditional on supplied responses; actual Rust/callback termination is still open. The membership project now binds source bytes and declaration cfg to a fresh captured Cargo build; this does not discharge Rust-to-model preservation or arithmetic/panic parameter interpretation.

Complete original checked slice batches and insertion callee; stable constructor forwards its exact input/empty-slice arguments. Successful results preserve capacity, establish identity uniqueness and exact voter/old-voter/learner sets and identity union. Acceptance holds iff voters are nonempty, each input is distinct, learners are disjoint from target voters, and the distinct identity union fits capacity; otherwise the result is Config. Stable results have no old voters and are not joint. Reachable callers, remaining membership transformations and Rust source/ownership/index/equality refinement remain open.

Complete original copied-field iterator projection with exact ordered output and source-record origin; composition with finalized preserves voter/learner sequences and empties old voters. Arbitrary capacities and holes are modeled. Constructor/caller invariants and Rust ownership/layout/lifetime and source-to-IR refinement remain open.

Complete original two-loop rebuild retains source voter projection, original-receiver is_voter exclusion, learner-prefix duplicate checks, insertion bodies and early errors. Checked capacity and unique identities, exact retained voter and replacement learner sets/identity union, no old voters/not-joint, and acceptance iff learners are distinct, in neither source voter set, and the distinct output union fits capacity; otherwise Config. Stable/nonempty source membership, authorization and log lifecycle remain reachable caller obligations. Rust source/ownership/index/equality refinement remains open.

Complete original body and Message::term helper lowered by the generic pure validator backend in proofs/message-validation. 56 kernel obligations characterize all variants on typed bounded views, including arbitrary finite batch lists below the i32 counter bound. Accepted batches are nonempty occupied prefixes with consecutive indices and positive, nondecreasing terms bounded by the message term. The batch contract is both necessary and sufficient; totality and absence of faults hold for every canonical validation view at fuel 256. Five source mutations are rejected on 32-bit. proofs/replication-contract composes accepted append validation with generated storage contracts. Lookup/truncation/push composition now derives the retained predecessor and space from the old state and scalar admission conditions. Field and advanced-term premises remain explicit. Source/borrow/layout refinement and complete append/step caller discharge remain open.

assumptions.A01: One cluster namespace, consistent genesis, unique lifetime identities, one live owner per identity; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A02: Authenticated, uncorrupted protocol messages from non-Byzantine participants in that namespace; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A03: Atomic durable writes of the exact `Write`, ordered per voter; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A04: Recovery uses that identity's permitted durable history; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A05: Host acknowledges only successful saves and consumes output according to API rules; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A06: Payloads and snapshots have stable logical values; Clone preserves those values; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A07: Application transitions are deterministic and snapshots represent exactly their declared applied prefix; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A08: Async backend cancellation cannot reorder abandoned writes after later transactions; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A09: Progress has eventual timely scheduling, communication and persistence for requisite voters; use sites and ownership: M0.md
assumptions.A10: Progress has sufficient capacity and counter headroom; use sites and ownership: M0.md

limitations: Root-to-item and transitive call/type/trait/derive resolution remain P01/P03/P05; inventoried call spellings are not resolved edges.
Rust source interpretation and ownership/layout preservation remain P04/P10; component evidence is not a source-level theorem.
All global composition and safety/progress requirements remain open; see requirement IDs and PROGRESS.md.
